topic: What adaptive coding strategies compensate for non-Gaussian noise statistics in reconciliation phases of CV-QKD over turbulent channels?
response: Multi-dimensional reconciliation via multi-edge LDPC codes is considered suitable for CV-QKD over satellite channels with low SNRs. Non-deterministic noiseless linear amplification can also be applied to distill improved CV entanglement and enhance QKD performance.
reference_context: The context highlights the challenges of reconciling binary information in CV-QKD, particularly in satellite communications where signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) are low. Multi-dimensional reconciliation via multi-edge LDPC codes is proposed as a suitable approach to compensate for non-Gaussian noise statistics.
